fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld, from the NewsArticle ld+json block) carry headline/articleBody-style fields plus a derived _paywalled flag; latest-mode records (S2-rss, dn.pt's /stories.rss feed) carry title/link-style fields and also include a near-full articleBody pulled from the feed's content:encoded.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (e.g. S1-jsonld, S2-rss).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind (e.g. not_found, http_500, blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

_paywalled.title: Paywalled
_paywalled.description: Article-mode only. True if dn.pt flagged this article as premium/subscription content (isAccessibleForFree:false and/or a .paywall hasPart marker in ld+json). This is a SOFT paywall -- articleBody is the full text either way; this flag just tells you the story is normally metered for real site visitors.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, from the NewsArticle ld+json node.

alternativeHeadline.title: Alternative headline
alternativeHeadline.description: Secondary/alternate headline field from ld+json -- usually empty on dn.pt.

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article summary/dek, from the NewsArticle ld+json node.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text. Article mode: from the NewsArticle ld+json node (untruncated even on premium/paywalled stories). Latest mode: reconstructed plain text from the RSS item's content:encoded HTML.

author.title: Author
author.description: Article mode: array of ld+json Person objects (name/givenName/url/image) -- dn.pt always emits this as an array even for a single byline. Latest mode: plain author name string from the RSS item's atom:author.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Comma-separated keyword string from ld+json (article mode) or the RSS item's media:keywords (latest mode) -- not an array.

articleSection.title: Section
articleSection.description: Section name from ld+json, e.g. "Sociedade", "Cultura", "Opiniao DN" (article mode only).

datePublished.title: Date published
datePublished.description: ISO 8601 publish date from ld+json (article mode only).

dateModified.title: Date modified
dateModified.description: ISO 8601 last-modified date from ld+json (article mode only).

dateCreated.title: Date created
dateCreated.description: ISO 8601 creation date from ld+json (article mode only).

inLanguage.title: Language
inLanguage.description: ISO language code from ld+json, e.g. "pt" (article mode only).

thumbnailUrl.title: Thumbnail URL
thumbnailUrl.description: Lead thumbnail image URL from ld+json (article mode only).

image.title: Image
image.description: Array of ld+json ImageObject entries (dn.pt serves 3 crop variants: 16:9, 4:3, 1:1), passed through as-is (article mode only).

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: ld+json NewsMediaOrganization publisher object (name/url/logo/sameAs socials), passed through as-is (article mode only).

mainEntityOfPage.title: Main entity of page
mainEntityOfPage.description: ld+json mainEntityOfPage WebPage reference (article mode only).

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline text of a latest-mode RSS item.

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL from the RSS item (latest mode only).

guid.title: GUID
guid.description: dn.pt's internal story UUID from the RSS item's guid element (latest mode only).

pubDate.title: Publication date
pubDate.description: RFC 822 publish timestamp from the RSS item's pubDate (latest mode only).

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Array of RSS <category> tag values, e.g. ["Opiniao DN", "colunistas"] (latest mode only).

section.title: Section (URL path)
section.description: URL path segment right after dn.pt/ (e.g. sociedade, cultura, opiniao-dn) derived from the RSS item's link -- latest mode only, since the feed carries no explicit section field.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
